turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Why does my new jumper already have little bobbles all over it?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's pilling. Short loose fibres rub together and twist into little balls, especially under the arms and on the sides.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sadly price doesn't always mean quality. Blends with lots of acrylic and very soft loose knits pill fastest.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm planning a surprise party for my best friend's thirtieth and I have a few ideas.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ooh, okay, listen to all of these first and then tell me your favorite.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One is renting the back room of her favorite restaurant for a dinner with about twenty people.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another option is a house party at my place with music and lots of snacks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or I could plan a smaller weekend trip with just her five closest friends.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's everything. Go on, rip them apart.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Does she like being the center of attention in a big crowd? If yes, the restaurant dinner is perfect. If she's more low key, the weekend with close friends would mean a lot.
